fields.subject: Request for Preservation of Records
fields.body:
The Federal Bureau of Investigation is investigating unauthorized access to the Airport Operational Database (AODB) and related flight information systems at North Coast International Airport, reported to this office on May 22, 2026.

Pursuant to 18 U.S.C. § 2703(f), you are requested to preserve, for a period of 90 days, all records and other evidence in your possession relating to the AODB SQL master server (10.66.0.10) and workstation OPS_INTERN_03 (192.168.1.55), including authentication and event logs, database transaction logs, firewall and proxy logs, email records for the intern account, and full disk images of both systems.

Please do not reboot, reimage or restore the affected systems without first coordinating with the case agent, as doing so may destroy volatile evidence. Restoration from backup on separate hardware is acceptable.

If you have questions, contact Special Agent Smith at (216) 555-0140. Thank you for your cooperation.
cc: R. Delgado, Director of Operations, NCIA
